resolution: Diagnosed the apparent shader-progress reversal as two separate editor hosts interleaving output, not one compiler losing progress. Process evidence: older reactjit-dev PID 2383706 started 03:46:08, is orphaned under PID 1, and writes stderr to /dev/pts/16; current reactjit-dev PID 2387306 started 03:49:41 under the active tools/rjit dev editor wrapper and writes to the same /dev/pts/16. Both compile the same 746 KB ground megashader about ten seconds apart, producing the alternating 12s/2s, 14s/4s sequence and consuming duplicate CPU. No repository change or process termination was made because the user asked why rather than authorizing a kill; the stale orphan is the exact stop target.
